## v0.1.8 - Dungeon Lighting, Door System, HUD Overhaul & AI Upgrades

**Dungeon Visuals**
- Prop lighting system - torches, braziers, candelabras, and ritual circles cast multi-tile radial glow with flicker and pulse animations
- Ambient darkness pass - dungeons feel genuinely dark with per-theme darkness levels; light sources carve bright pools through the gloom
- Fog-of-war light modulation - revealed tiles near light sources appear brighter through the fog
- 5 new prop particle effects (candelabra glow, ritual pulse, bioluminescent spores, brazier embers, fountain mist)
- 7 new room archetypes (Grand Cathedral, Ritual Chamber, Torture Chamber, Burial Ground, Armory, Ossuary, Fungal Grotto)
- Prop placement budget system - rooms now have curated focal props and accent limits instead of random scatter
- Room door system - wall separators with chokepoint doors now generate at room boundaries with role-aware placement chances

**HUD and UI**
- New player HP bar - dedicated 20px gradient frame with class identity, color-coded HP states, and low-HP danger pulse
- Party HP bars - all party members display HP bars side by side above the viewport
- Minimap relocated to right sidebar panel, auto-scales to fill panel width
- Dungeon HUD expanded to 4-row grid layout with dedicated vitals row
- Combat Meter button now shows a "Meter" label
- Inventory panel widened to prevent text overflow and horizontal scrollbar

**Particle Effects**
- Seal of Judgment (Inquisitor) - gold star burst with diamond rune extras and golden trail
- Blink (Mage) - arcane blue star burst at destination with fading departure trail
- Bone Shield, Dark Pact, Profane Ward, Enrage, Frenzy Aura - new enemy skill particles and persistent buff auras

**AI Improvements**
- All AI units (enemies and allies) can now open doors with door-aware pathfinding
- Hero AI allies seek out and open treasure chests when idle, with per-stance seek ranges
- AI parties now spawn with unique class compositions (no duplicate classes per team)
- PVPVE team leader deadlock fix - leaders no longer freeze in narrow corridors

**Loot and Chests**
- PVPVE location-based chest tiers - chests near map center roll higher tiers for risk/reward
- Loot rarity rebalance - Rare drops reduced to 7% base, steeper floor bonus curve, chest tier mapping fixed

**Bug Fixes**
- Fixed party HP panels biased to the left instead of centered
- Fixed party HP bars missing on first frame of match
- Fixed hero permadeath not applying to AI hero allies
- Fixed PVPVE chests always being Wooden tier

**3987 tests passing**
